content.value: If you are a patient looking to make a payment,
please click here to Make a Payment

The Payment Plan feature allows a patient with a large outstanding balance to pay it off over time. Multiple payment plans can be created for the same patient. This feature allows the user to create and view payment plan details. Credit card payments can also be voided and non-credit card (cash/check) payments can be recorded in athenaOne. In addition, credit card payments not made via athenahealth's Credit Card Plus (CCP) can be recorded as having been made, however, we highly recommend using CCP (and /collectpayment). The Payment Reference allows the user to view the configured list of payment methods for the practice. For more information, please refer Payment Plans.

primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Creates a payment plan for the patient. If payment is to be made via a credit card than provide the appropriate credit card fields.

email.description: The email address of the patient

frequency.description: How often should the patient be billed (ONETIMEON - One-time charge, WEEKLY - Weekly, BIWEEKLY - Every two weeks, TWICEAMONTH - First and fifteenth of month, MONTHLY - Monthly, MONTHLYFIRSTBUSDAY - Monthly, first business day, MONTHLYLASTBUSDAY - Monthly, last business day).

startdate.description: The date the plan should start. Defaulted to tomorrow. If you set something to start today, it will NOT get billed today; it will be billed on the same day one month from today. Future payments of credit card plans will be billed on the same day of the month as the start date. For example, if the start date is 01/15, then the credit card will be billed for the second time on 02/15.

trackdata.description: The track data obtained from the credit card swipe. This can be track1 and/or track2 data. In either case, please including the start and end sentinels. ("%" and "?" for track1 and ";" and "?" for track2.)

billingzip.description: The billing zipcode for the credit card.  (Required if track data is not supplied.)

nameoncard.description: The name on the credit card.  (Required if trackdata is not supplied; track 2 does NOT supply name.)  Please truncate at 30 characters. (Max length: 30)

percentage.description: The percentage of the current outstanding balance that the patient should be billed each period.

cycleamount.description: The amount the patient is to be billed per cycle.

departmentid.description: The ID of the department where the payment or contract is being collected.

todayservice.description: Apply the other amount value to today's service.

accountnumber.description: The account number of the credit card.  (Required if trackdata is not supplied.)

appointmentid.description: The ID of the appointment where the copay should be applied.

billingmethod.description: Valid values are SENDSTATEMENTS or CREDITCARD.

ecommercemode.description: Use ECommerce credit card mode (e.g. for telemedicine). trackdata may NOT be used if this mode is true.

billingaddress.description: The billing address for the credit card.  (Required if track data is not supplied.)  If more than 20 characters, please truncate. (Max length: 20)

paymentplanname.description: The name of the payment plan.

cardsecuritycode.description: The CVV2: the 3 (or 4 for Amex) digit value normally found on the back (or front for Amex) of the credit card.  When creating contracts, this is required if using accountnumber instead of track data.

expirationmonthmm.description: The month the credit card expires (MM).  (Required if trackdata is not supplied.)

expirationyearyyyy.description: The year the credit card expires (YYYY).  (Required if trackdata is not supplied.)

epaymentid.description:
After a successful payment, this ID can be used to retrieve
				the receipt.

errortext.description: The error text returned by the credit card processor.

paymentplanid.description: The ID of the payment plan.

success.description: true for success.  false for an error.

inputParameters.name: paymentplanids
inputParameters.description: One or more payment plan IDs.

inputParameters.name: linkedclaiminfo
inputParameters.description: Get claims covered by the payment plan

amountdue.description: Remaining amount due for the patient.

billingmethod.description: Billing method of the payment plan.

cycleamount.description: The amount the patient is billed per cycle.

downpayment.description: Down payment billed to the patient.

frequency.description: How often should the patient be billed (ONETIMEON - One-time charge, WEEKLY - Weekly, BIWEEKLY - Every two weeks, TWICEAMONTH - First and fifteenth of month, MONTHLY - Monthly, MONTHLYFIRSTBUSDAY - Monthly, first business day, MONTHLYLASTBUSDAY - Monthly, last business day).

numfuturepayments.description: Number of future payments the patient has to make.

paymentplanid.description: Unique id of the payment plan.

selectedclaims.description: Claims covered by the payment plan

referenceEndpoints.endpointTitle: Get list of non-credit-card payment methods
referenceEndpoints.endpointDescription: Retrieves a list of valid credit card methods for practices not using CCP for use with /patients/{patientid}/recordpayment

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: Number of entries to return (default 1500, max 5000)

name.description: The name of this payment method (used in athenahealth's UI).

paymentmethod.description: The payment method identifier for use in /patients/{patientid}/recordpayment
